content: पृष्ठतस् {%ind.%} .²1 Behind, behind the back, from behind; गच्छतः पृष्ठतोऽन्वियात् <ls>Ms. 4. 154</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 300</ls>; नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते <ls>Bg. 11. 40</ls>. .²2 Towards the back, backwards; गच्छ पृष्ठतः. .²3 On the back. .²4 Behind the back, secretly, covertly. (पृष्ठतः कृ means .²1 to place on the back, leave behind. .²2 to neglect, forsake, abandon. .²3 to renounce, desist from, leave off, resign; येनाशाः पृष्ठतः कृत्वा नैराश्यमवलम्बितम् <ls>H. 1. 124</ls>; लज्जां पृष्टतः कृत्वा <ls>K.</ls>; पृष्ठतो गम् to follow; पृष्ठतो भू .²1 to stand at the back. .²2 to be disregarded.)
